page0.text: Soon after Fuji-nee leaves, I lock up and Sakura and I leave as well.
page0.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page0:1

page1.text:
"..."
"Sakura? What's wrong? You don't look good. Are you still feeling sick?"
page1.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page1:1

page2.text:
"Eh? Oh, no. I'm feeling better. What about you? You didn't look well this morning, and the injury you had from yesterday might have gotten worse."
Yesterday's injury?
Oh, the bruise on my left hand.
page2.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page2:1

page3.text:
"Well, the bruise hasn't changed much. My hand just swelled up, so it should get better soon."
"..."
Sakura continues to stare at me, looking concerned.
page3.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page3:1

page4.text:
"Uh, I'm fine. Really. It's nothing."
"..."
"What's going on? You've been acting weird since yesterday, Sakura. This is just a bruise. Or what... Is this your way of admitting it happened because you came in the middle of the night and stomped on my hand while I was sleeping?"
page4.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page4:1

page5.text:
"S-Senpai! I'm not that heavy! I was just...well..."
"Just, what?"
"...I just hope it's just my mistake..."
page5.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page5:1

page6.text:
"Huh?"
I don't get what Sakura's saying.
Sakura may be quiet, but she generally speaks her mind.
It's not like her to beat around the bush so much.
page6.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page6:1

page7.text:
"Senpai. I would like to ask you a favor."
"Sure, as long as it's within something I can do. What's up?"
"Well, I can't come help you tonight and tomorrow. So...at least for then, will you try to stay in your home as much as possible?"
page7.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page7:1

page8.text:
"Huh? Are you saying I need to skip work on Sunday, too?"
"Yes. I would like you to stay in your house as much as you can. Um, I'll come back and help once I'm done with my errand."
page8.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page8:1

page9.text:
"Hmmm. Well, I guess skipping one day of work wouldn't hurt.
Okay. I'll just hang around the house all day over the weekend. Is that what you want, Sakura?"
"Yes. That would be a really big help."
page9.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page9:1

page10.sourceUnit: セイバールート三日目-10:page10:1
